dish: classic cocktails — the house 'Sapporo' and a Hennessy sidecar
address: Katsumi Bldg 4F, Minami 3-jō Nishi 3-3, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Susukino's authentic bar since 1958, founded by one of Japan's longest-serving bartenders — order the vodka 'Sapporo' and leave with a paper-cut silhouette of your profile.

dish: jazz café-bar — 15,000 records, no cover charge
n: Jazz Café Bossa, Tanukikōji (ジャズ喫茶 BOSSA)
w: A Tanukikōji jazz kissa open since 1971 whose owner's 15,000 records and CDs have carried Sapporo's jazz scene for half a century.

dish: 'Miyoshino set' — six gyoza with curry rice and miso soup
n: Miyoshino Tanukikōji (みよしの 狸小路店)
address: Minami 3-jō Nishi 2-chōme 16-4 (Tanukikōji 2-chōme), Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Sapporo's own gyoza-and-curry chain — the cult combo plate of six dumplings beside a pool of curry rice.
